pool.text: Killke people constructed the walled complex of Saksayhuamán around this year.
Cusco fell to Huáscar's sphere during the Inca Civil War.
Captured by Atahualpa's generals in April during the Battle of Quipaipan.
First three Spaniards arrived in May after the Battle of Cajamarca.
Francisco Pizarro officially arrived in Cusco on 15 November.
City reestablished on 23 March after Spanish conquest, built over Inca monuments.
Congress of Americanists declared Cusco Archeological Capital of the Americas.
Anthem of Cusco composed by Roberto Ojeda Campana with lyrics by Luis Nieto Miranda.
Major earthquake on 21 May damaged more than one third of structures.
Declared Cultural Heritage of the Nation by Supreme Resolution No.
Flag introduced by Raúl Montesinos Espejo for radio station anniversary.
Mayor signed ordinance banning traditional spelling, enforcing "Cusco" in publications.
Municipality officially adopted the flag after its popular use.
7th Convention of Mayors declared Cusco Cultural Heritage of the World.
Declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO as "City of Cusco".
Coat of arms featuring Sol de Echenique officially adopted.
Local authorities formalized Quechua‑related spelling "Qosqo" for the city.
Anthem translated into Quechua by Faustino Espinoza Navarro and Mario Mejía Waman.
Constitution designates Cusco as the Historical Capital of Peru.
Tourism income reached US$837 million.
